title: Doner Wrap with Thai Flair
description: A twist on traditional street food, this Thai-inspired doner wrap is packed with flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the doner meat and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the fish sauce (if using) and coconut milk.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Warm the light wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the doner meat mixture onto a wrap, followed by chopped cilantro, a lime wedge, pickled carrots, sliced cucumber, and crushed peanuts.
Cook the doner meat to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
Adjust the amount of curry paste to taste.
For an extra crispy wrap, grill the wraps for 30-60 seconds on each side.
